annotation.title_clean: House Bill 381 / Senate Bill 151: An Act to amend Tennessee Code Annotated relative to autonomous vehicles (Safe Automated Vehicles (SAVE) Act)
annotation.title_en: House Bill 381 / Senate Bill 151: An Act to amend Tennessee Code Annotated relative to autonomous vehicles (Safe Automated Vehicles (SAVE) Act)
annotation.summary_en: Tennessee bill (HB 381/SB 151) amending state code to accommodate automated driving systems and creating the Safe Automated Vehicles (SAVE) chapter. Manufacturers self-certify to the revenue department, keep incident records, publish privacy statements, assume liability when the ADS is at fault, and local governments are preempted.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines the engaged ADS as the 'driver', 'operator' and 'person' for ADS-operated vehicles.
Manufacturers may start SAVE projects by self-certifying to the Department of Revenue (ADS, crash notification, data recorder).
Manufacturers assume liability when the ADS is at fault, and are immune for unauthorized modifications.
Manufacturers must keep incident records, report safety summaries and publish a privacy statement.
Local governments are preempted; operating without a human driver outside the chapter is a Class A misdemeanor.
